title: Activate dark env flags
depends_on: H7 (citation flag depends on real corpus)
summary: PR-20 shipped four prompt-engineering surfaces dark behind env flags. PR-9 also shipped GENERATION_CACHE_ENABLED. H8 turns each on for a per-tenant subset (school_id allow-list), runs an A/B baseline through the eval harness (PR-5), and either rolls forward (full activation) or rolls back (per-flag).

flags_to_activate.rollout: Per-school allow-list. Pick 5 friendly schools. Eval-harness baseline; if no regression after 2 weeks, expand to 50% of schools then 100%.
Subject-by-subject. Start with maths (best test coverage). Extend after 1 week eval-clean per subject.
Question-type-by-question-type. Start with extended-answer English Lit (where consistency matters most). Watch token cost; expand if cost-acceptable.
Subject-by-subject. Requires H7 citation corpus production loader. Start with history (high-citation density).
Verify PR-9's PII redaction in production logs first. Then enable for all schools. Cache hit rate target: 30% within 30 days.

in: server/lib/featureFlags.ts (new, ~150 LoC) — per-school allow-list resolution + per-subject scope + per-question-type scope
server/db/schema.sql — feature_flag_school table (school_id, flag_name, enabled, scope_json)
client/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx — UI for flag toggles + per-school + per-subject scope
scripts/eval-flag-baseline.mjs (new) — one-shot script that runs the eval harness with each flag on/off and compares pass rates
Targeted vitest: flag resolution logic; scope hierarchy (school > subject > question-type)
out: Feature-flag UI for non-admin users (deferred — v1 is admin-only)

acceptance_criteria: Flag resolver is pure: same (school_id, subject, questionType, flag_name) → same enabled boolean.
Each existing flag's downstream surface honours the new resolver in place of the env-only check.
eval-flag-baseline.mjs runs each flag on/off through the existing PR-5 fixtures and outputs a JSON report.
Admin panel shows current flag state per school; toggle is 1-click with a 'Are you sure?' confirm.
Backwards compatible: env-only mode (no DB row) continues to work for self-hosted deployments.
tsc --noEmit clean; npm test passes; npm run eval:worksheets passes per-flag.
